headline: Bank of Japan Keeps Interest Rate at 1.25%, Raises 2027 Inflation Outlook
summary: The Bank of Japan maintained its policy interest rate at 1.25% annually while raising its inflation forecast for 2027.
why: Central bank policy rates and inflation projections dictate monetary conditions, impacting currency valuation, bond yields, and equity market trends in Japan.

impacts.name: Japan Policy Rate
impacts.why: The central bank left its benchmark rate unchanged at 1.25%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Maintaining the benchmark rate at 1.25% alongside an upward revision to inflation forecasts influenced Japanese monetary policy expectations.
